notes: The parts catalogue, as in Osmia: parts with a part number, description, unit and images, in nested categories (e.g. Hardware > Fasteners). Each category lists the attributes its parts have (thread, material, ...); sub-categories inherit their parents' attributes. Parts list the parts they mate with (two-way), the parts they accept (a housing accepts its crimp contacts; the contact shows the housing under Fits into), and can be archived.

apps.name: Parts
apps.description: The parts catalogue: what each part is, how it is categorised, and which parts go together. Quantities and locations are not part of this app.

tables.name: Categories
tables.description: Nested categories (e.g. Hardware > Fasteners). Each lists the attributes its parts have; sub-categories inherit their parents' attributes.

fields.name: Parent category
fields.help: Leave empty for a top-level category.

fields.name: Attributes
fields.help: What parts in this category are described by, e.g. Thread, Length, Material. The hint is shown as an example.

tables.name: Parts
tables.description: Parts only describe things. Untick Active to archive a part.

fields.name: Attributes
fields.help: The attributes of the part's category.

fields.name: Mates with
fields.help: Parts this one connects to, both ways: e.g. a 9-pin plug mates with a 9-socket receptacle.

fields.name: Accepts
fields.help: Parts used in or with this one: e.g. a D-sub housing accepts its crimp contacts.
